name: ES-9
source: es9_user_manual_1.3.pdf p.6-7 (Inputs and Outputs, panel photo p.6)
notes: Panel prints only numbers: inputs 1-14 (white block), outputs 1-8 (left column), plus headphone symbol and L/R for the main outs. 3.5mm I/O are DC-coupled; main outs are 1/4" TRS balanced and AC-coupled; phones is a 1/4" stereo jack (DC-coupled) with volume knob. Default DAW mapping: 3.5mm outs = DAW 9-16, main = 1/2, phones = mix of 1/2 & 3/4, inputs = DAW 1-14. Front-panel optical TOSLINK S/PDIF In/Out and USB-C not listed (not patch jacks). Rear ES-5 (GT1) and MIDI breakout (GT2) headers not listed.
